get.summary:
Retrieves per-calendar-day spend points for the user's active accounts for the current and
previous period. The period is resolved from `timePeriod` plus `recordedDate`.
Days without activity are zero-filled.
Gets a Transactions associated with the authenticated user and the specified Id.

Retrieves headline transaction aggregates (count, spend, income, net flow) for the user's
active accounts for the current and previous period. The period is resolved from
`timePeriod` plus `recordedDate`.

Retrieves Transactions associated with the authenticated user
based on the provided search criteria.

post.summary: Creates a new UserGoogleSpreadsheet for the authenticated user and the specified Google Spreadsheet.

get.summary: Lists UserGoogleSpreadsheets associated with the authenticated user.

delete.summary: Soft-deletes (deactivates) a user google spreadsheet owned by the authenticated user.

parameters.name: spreadsheetId
parameters.description: The identifier of the data spreadsheet to delete.

get.summary: Gets a UserGoogleSpreadsheet for the authenticated user and the specified Google Spreadsheet.

parameters.name: userGoogleSpreadsheetId
parameters.description: Id of the UserGoogleSpreadsheet to retrieve.

get.summary: Retrieves spending activity for the authenticated user for a given period.
Retrieves spending over time summary for the authenticated user.
Gets an Institution with the specified Id.

Retrieves distinct institutions for the authenticated user.
Only includes institutions that have at least one active account belonging to the user.
Retrieves active Institutions based on the provided search criteria.

Retrieves the total balance breakdown for the user's active accounts for the current and
previous period.
Period totals are sourced from the most recent balance ledger entry
on or before each period's end (last known balances are carried forward).
Accounts without a ledger entry that far back appear in that period's
breakdown with a zero balance.
Gets the Account associated with the authenticated user that has the specified Id.

parameters.name: accountId
parameters.description: The Id of the account to retrieve.

get.summary:
Retrieves account-level summary for a specific institution.
Period totals are sourced from the most recent balance ledger entry
on or before each period's end (last known balances are carried forward;
accounts without a ledger entry that far back carry a zero balance).
The per-account-type totals are zero-filled for every active account type.
If the institution is deactivated no accounts are returned, but the
institution name and zero-filled totals are.

parameters.name: institutionId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the institution.
